notes.title: Solution to purchasing DLC issues
notes.notes: Due to the compatibility issue with the DLC program, which is currently being repaired, we have decided to integrate the top player DLC into the first round of benefits. The integration update will be carried out in a few hours, and the corresponding items will be automatically unlocked in the game. At the same time, players who have already purchased DLC will receive an additional set of special clothing as compensation after the compatibility issue is resolved. We deeply apologize for your poor gaming experience.

notes.title: Update plan
notes.notes:
I am glad that the game Death Zone can meet with all players on Steam. The game originally planned to be launched in October had to be urgently modified due to content review issues, which forced the original planned release content to be shelved and postponed. However, I believe that the next version update will be met with all players soon. Please continue to pay attention to the latest announcement of the game version. Thank you.
